period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the 3rd Quarter ended 30 September 2019 (Unaudited)"), downloaded directly from the bank's live financial-statements archive (legacy.citybankplc.com/report/financialstatements), not Wayback Machine. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 September 2019' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the 3rd Quarter ended 30 September 2019') figures are used, not the explicitly-labelled 'Consolidated' panels (which include a 'Transferred to Minority Interest' line and different totals, e.g. Consolidated NPAT 2,621,645,091 and EPS 2.58 vs Solo NPAT 2,526,331,253 and EPS 2.49). Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 320,615,219,876 + Shareholders' equity 25,586,182,792 = Total assets 346,201,402,668 exactly; Net interest income 8,040,783,078 + Investment income 1,379,120,944 + Commission 2,326,003,761 + Other operating income 1,775,376,949 = Total operating income 13,521,284,732 exactly. Year-to-date NPAT (2,526,331,253) minus the 2019_Q2.json H1 figure (1,701.58m) implies a Q3-alone NPAT of ~824.8m, which matches this filing's own 'Current Quarter' column net profit after taxation (824,752,728) closely -- cross-validated against the already-completed 2019_Q2 quarter; the 2018 comparative column here (2,081,709,071) also matches this session's newly-added 2018_Q3.json net_profit_after_tax_cumulative exactly. This filing includes an explicit Note 4.a 'Net Assets Value per Share (NAV) - The City Bank Limited' (Solo basis), so nav_per_share is reported here (not calculated). Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported).
